title: Breanna's Cleaning & Yard Care
tagline: A website for a house cleaning and yard care business in Lancaster, PA.
stateNote: A live site for a real local business, built as client work.
problem: A small service business needed a clear site with services, starting prices and an easy way to get in touch.
audience: Homeowners in and around Lancaster, PA.
contribution: I designed and built the site in static HTML, CSS and JavaScript. The source is private.
worksToday: Services and starting prices from the business's own materials.
Call, text and email links, and a quote form that opens an email draft.
Three design directions were built for the owner to compare.
limitations: There is no online booking; the quote form prepares an email.

media.alt: The Breanna's Cleaning & Yard Care home page: 'A fresh home. A happy yard. A little more you time.'
media.caption: The home screen of the hosted build.

involve.headline: Need a site for your service business?
asks: Tell me what your business does and I'll tell you honestly what a site would take.
